messages:
josh: FYI we lost keystore decrypts in ap-south after a route tighten at 01:10 UTC. ~10% of warm-pool GPU nodes failed to fetch ephemeral tokens.
priya: that was my change to narrow the egress CIDR to close a misconfigured host. didn't expect keystore traffic to be affected.
alex: keystore proxy shows `kms.DecryptTimeout` + `connection reset` spikes exactly during the rollout window.
rachel: security: audit sampler shows gaps for ~35m. we need request ids and affected instance ids for compliance.
sam: warm pool went from 120 -> 108 joinable nodes. no product impact yet but less burst headroom. rewarm queued.
josh: can you paste bootstrap log snippet?
priya: snippet: ```[2026-03-20T01:11:05Z] boot fetch-keystore id=inst-apb-11 err="kms.DecryptTimeout"```
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: keystore-decrypt spike ap-south 01:10-01:15 UTC (72 events). PD notified.
deploy-bot: Route rollback started: chg-20260320-rtb-rollback.
alex: rollback performed, but the proxy still reports TLS handshake failures from NAT IPs — conntrack at 610k on the proxy host.
lina: cost impact: NATGW burst fallback spilled traffic to transit gateway for ~25m; estimate ~$300 extra egress. tagging incident.
priya: I uploaded the route diff: s3://infra-debug/ap-south/2026-03-20/rtb-diff.txt and saved rollback id.
rachel: record retention: pull decrypt request ids and ship to longterm audit bucket for the 01:05-01:45 window.
sam: immediate mitigations: scale proxy replicas + increase conntrack limit + enqueue rewarm with exponential backoff. scaling proxy x3 now.
josh: long-term: keystore traffic must prefer privatelink and never fall back to NAT. add canary rollout policy for any route table edits touching keystore prefixes.
alex: temp iptables to drop stale NAT IPs reduced noise: `sudo iptables -I INPUT -s 100.64.12.0/24 -j DROP` (will revert after stability).
priya: will schedule a controlled reapply with prefix canary next week. won't touch global route table without smoke tests.
lina: I'll add a cost alert and include the ~USD300 in the monthly anomaly report.
rachel: security actions: 1) preserve request ids 2) add keystore sampler alert threshold 3) file postmortem for compliance.
sam: adding preflight to runbook: - privatelink reachability curl check - conntrack headroom check - simulated bootstrap token fetch.
josh: assign owners: eng-infra (priya/alex) canary rollout + preflight; eng-sre (sam) runbook + conntrack automation; eng-platform (josh/lina) cost alert + audit preservation; eng-security (rachel) compliance note. reconvene after canary redo. :thumbsup:
